description: Start a background job that creates one account per distinct propertyKey value and adds each contact seen with it as a member. Accounts are named from nameKey, otherwise after the work email domain most of their contacts share; existing names, domains and roles are kept. No emails are sent, no sync rules run and no segment-entered sequences start. Returns jobId, alreadyRunning (a run for the same key was already queued or running, so none was started) and job; check progress with get_account_organization_id_job. Reruns update the same accounts instead of duplicating them. Only call after the user confirmed the preview. Fails with a 409 error while contacts use a custom attribute named `account` or `account.*`.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

nameKey.description: Optional property or attribute holding the organization name, e.g. workspaceName.

propertyKey.description: Event property or contact attribute holding your organization ID, e.g. workspaceId (from detect_account_organization_ids).

source.description: Where the ID lives: event (default) for event properties, attribute for contact attributes.

name: create_accounts_from_organization_id

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `create_accounts_from_organization_id` MCP tool.

alreadyRunning.description: True when a run for this key was already queued or running.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

job.description: The job status (jobId, state, settings, result, error); when alreadyRunning, settings are the running job's record returned by Sequenzy.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
